title: A right stop near the column edge ends the segment on the stop whatever its width; a stop past the edge lands on the edge; a passed stop collapses the tab
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-11-07): 11920 x 16860 page, 1133 margins (column 9654 twips, edge x 539.35 pt), Arial 10.5 titles with a 10 pt raised page number; right stop 9524: number ink ends 532.88 for '14' and '7', plain and decimalZero-numbered hanging lines alike; stop 9654 and 9798: number ends 539.38 (column edge); stop 9510: 532.18; title ink past 521.72 (stop - number width): number follows the title directly (522.39-533.56, 527.06-538.22) on one line; title ending 532.29 / 536.96: tab + number wrap to a second line ending on the stop; dot leader fills title end -> number

cases.note: numbered TOC line: the one right stop past the indent boxes the page number flush to 9524
stop past the column edge: the emitter clamps the box at the edge (min(stop, 100%))
leader stops stay on the tab-size grid (the leader needs the measured title end)
two tabs on the line: grid
left stop: Chromium grid sized by the first stop past the indent
